name: The Entropy
source:
"I am suddenly stranded in the sea of stars, then i met her, a living mystery right in front of me."

Welcome to the Entropy! Where you are greeted by an entity that called herself the "Navigator", depending on your actions, you will be given an option where you choose how you interact with her, so how will you end up?

[from [url=https://dreamerrii.itch.io/the-entropy]itch.io[/url]]
